company_name: IRSA Inversiones Y Representaciones S.A. Global
title: Result – Series XXV Notes Issuance
summary: La entrada Result – Series XXV Notes Issuance se publicó primero en IRSA .
body_markdown:
##### The company announces the issuance of its Series XXV Notes in the local capital market for an amount of USD 50 million, according to the following information:


**Nominal value of bids received:** USD 64,496,456


Nominal value to be issued: USD 50,000,000


Pro Rata Allocation Factor: 60.0614%.


**Interest Rate:** 3.75%.


**Issue price:** 100.00%.


**Issuance and Settlement Date:** June 8, 2026


Maturity Date: June 8, 2027


Interest payments: semiannually


Amortization: 100% at maturity


Proceeds will be used primarily to refinance existing liabilities and working capital in Argentina.
